race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
race.verdict: HERAKLES should be spot on for this following a couple of recent spins here and may well land a fourth C&D success. Simba's Pride also looks interesting given the forecast strong pace, and he heads the dangers along with Southwell specialist Toptime , who could go well on just his second start at this track. Believeinmenow and Sunday River complete the shortlist for this wide-open sprint. HERAKLES (IRE) SIMBA'S PRIDE TOPTIME
race.bettingForecast: Simba's Pride (7/2), Hi Lord (4/1), Toptime (8/1), Miss Rainbow (8/1), Justmyluck (10/1), Too Much (10/1), Water Of Leith (12/1), Believeinmenow (12/1), Sunday River (14/1), Herakles (16/1), The Tunguska Event (16/1), Contorno (20/1), Fordham Flyer (25/1), Cast No Shadow (25/1)
